no_outcome_promised.note: Acknowledges the reversal request without promising or implying it will be granted.

no_liability_admitted.note: No admission of fault or apology that concedes error. It thanks the customer and acknowledges frustration only.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: The fee amount and circumstances are restated from the complaint. The only timeline is the standard 10 business days. Offering to pass along further information is not a described procedure.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance, priority or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the $12 fee, the balance drop, that this is a first occurrence, and the one-time reversal request.

tone.note: Warm and respectful. Minor point: 'small, unexpected charge can be frustrating' slightly overstates the customer's relaxed 'not a big deal' framing. The customer never called the charge unexpected. The analyst may wish to soften this, but it is not disqualifying.

mode_respected.note: Events are framed as the customer's account ('You told us'). It takes no position on the request, refers generically to a specialist team, and does not name Deposit Operations.
